about_the_game:
Trapped in the dark halls of a medieval dungeon, the last of the penis warriors fight for survival against grotesque monsters and cruel overlords. Every attempt brings you deeper into a world of stone walls, cursed chambers, and strange secrets. Only through growth, cunning, and raw strength can you escape.

Gameplay

Penis Dungeon combines fast-paced action with RPG progression. Each run is procedurally generated, filled with enemies, traps, bosses, and puzzles. Choose your hero, gather weapons, and unlock upgrades through a versatile skill tree. Death is permanent — but every failure teaches you, granting blueprints, skills, and knowledge to push further next time.

Whether alone or with a friend in local co-op, players must experiment with builds, find the right weapon combinations, and adapt to ever-changing challenges.

Features

  • Roguelike Action RPG – procedurally generated dungeons, bosses, and loot.

  • Deep Progression – over 30 skills across multiple branches: offense, defense, mobility, and utility.

  • Varied Arsenal – discover weapons, craft from blueprints, and adapt your fighting style.

  • Online Co-op – fight alongside a friend and combine strengths.

  • Replayability – no two runs are the same, with new challenges and secrets each time.

  • Mod Support – extend and reshape the dungeon to your liking.

Do you have the strength, cunning, and stamina to break free from the dungeon… or will you join the countless fallen?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized cartoon characters that resemble genitals, used purely for humorous and artistic purposes. There is no sexual or erotic content, no sexual themes, no nudity with sexual intent, and no explicit acts or dialogue.

  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200 or AMD Athlon XE BE-2300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 or AMD Radeon R5 Graphics
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 460
